Arduino Uno.name: Arduino Nano
Arduino Uno.reason: Compact pin-compatible ATmega328P board at ~45% lower cost.

Arduino Uno.name: ESP32
Arduino Uno.reason: Higher clock speed (240MHz vs 16MHz), dual-core, and integrated Wi-Fi/BLE.

ESP32.name: ESP8266 (NodeMCU)
ESP32.reason: Cheaper Wi-Fi enabled SoC when dual-core and BLE are not required.

Raspberry Pi.name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
Raspberry Pi.reason: Compact quad-core SBC that consumes far less power and costs 60% less.

HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor.name: RCWL-1601 Ultrasonic Sensor
HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor.reason: Drop-in pin-compatible ultrasonic sensor supporting both 3.3V and 5V directly.

HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor.name: US-100 Ultrasonic Sensor
HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor.reason: Includes built-in temperature compensation for millimeter-accurate distance measurement.

Temperature Sensor.name: LM35 Temperature Sensor
Temperature Sensor.reason: Low-cost analog temperature sensor with linear 10mV/°C scale.

Temperature Sensor.name: DHT22 / AM2302
Temperature Sensor.reason: Higher accuracy (±0.5°C vs ±2°C) and wider humidity sensing range (0-100%).

OLED.name: 0.91 inch I2C OLED (128x32)
OLED.reason: Smaller form factor and lower cost display for compact telemetry readouts.

OLED.name: LCD 1602 with I2C
OLED.reason: High-contrast character display with long operational life and zero burn-in risk.

LCD.name: 0.96 inch I2C OLED
LCD.reason: Crisper graphical UI rendering with lower power consumption.

Bluetooth.name: ESP32 (Built-in BLE)
Bluetooth.reason: Consolidates controller and Bluetooth into a single module, eliminating external serial wiring.

DC Motor.name: Micro Coreless DC Motor
DC Motor.reason: Extremely lightweight low-current motor for miniature mechanisms.

Servo Motor.name: MG90S Metal Gear Servo
Servo Motor.reason: Durable metal gearing prevents gear stripping under high mechanical torque.

Relay.name: TIP120 Darlington Transistor Switch
Relay.reason: Solid-state DC switching without noisy mechanical click or contact arcing.

Relay.name: Solid State Relay (SSR)
Relay.reason: Silent, spark-free AC switching with optical isolation and indefinite switching lifespan.
